case_number: 2024 INSC 550; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 7933 OF 2024 @ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 25631 OF 2019
summary: Concealment of pending criminal cases in recruitment verification; forgery of police certificates; standard: preponderance of evidence; disciplinary inquiry found respondent concealed cases registered under IPC and UP Goondas Act; fake documents submitted to counter allegations; verification revealed coaching institute certificate fabricated; termination upheld as proportionate to misconduct; High Court erred in reinstating with liberty to impose minor punishment; deliberate non-disclosure during recruitment fatal to employment.
legal_provisions_cited: Central Reserve Police Force Rules, 1955 r.27
Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970 s.3(1)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; termination of services restored; reinstatement with back-wages quashed.
